name: suggest_model_switch
description: Recommend switching the active Claude model before ingesting large external context for a straightforward task. The host should present a confirmation UI or perform an automatic swap per user settings. Call this INSTEAD of proceeding on Opus when the cost gate triggers.

current_model.description: Active model identifier, e.g. claude-opus-4-6 or opus.

recommended_model.description: Cheaper model tier that fits the task.

recommended_model_id.description: Concrete model slug for the host to apply, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6 or claude-haiku-4-5. Omit to let the host map tier to default.

task_summary.description: One-line description of what the user asked for.

task_class.description: Classification result. Only call this tool when straightforward.

context_refs.description: URLs, file paths, PR numbers, Jira keys, etc.

estimated_input_tokens.description: Estimated tokens to ingest before any summarization.

context_band.description: Threshold band from the skill heuristics.

rationale.description: Brief explanation for the user: why cheaper model is sufficient.

scoped_ingest_plan.description: How to fetch less context after switch, e.g. grep errors only, PR files matching src/.

auto_switch.description: If true, host may switch without prompt when user has opted into auto-switch.

preserve_context.description: If true, host should carry user message and gate metadata into the new session.
